item.title: Controller Anti-Cheat Enforcement & Ban Wave Update — 09/02/2026
item.description:
We are implementing significant, new systems to detect players using unauthorized controller hardware or software in Apex Legends on all platforms including: PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2.

We’ve spent the past several months thoroughly validating these systems to ensure they can accurately identify prohibited behavior.

Players that trigger these detections will be actioned upon and banned accordingly.

item.description:
